pages: atlas_r380 (units, buildings, icons) + atlas_r380fx (blast aftermath) + atlas_r380fx2 (nuke2 hybrid blast); each name in one page
anchor: kind building/ruin/ground: draw at (cell_x*4 - ax, (cell_y + fd)*4 - ay), cell = NW cell of the footprint
anchor_units: kind unit*/fx*: ax, ay = anchor pixel (draw at world_px - (ax, ay)); frame = state*dirs + dir, dir k = heading k*22.5 deg clockwise from east (k=0 east, 4 south, 12 north). Strips are trimmed to their content, so always use each sprite's own w/h/ax/ay
local_px: per-dir lists are px offsets from the unit anchor with the 3/4 lift included; building points ("door", "spots", ...) are frame-local px

nuke2_flash.note: hard 5-step flash at impact: frame 0 for 0-0.07 s, frame 1 for 0.07-0.14 s; draw above the fireball, then nothing

nuke2_fireball.note: rising fireball 0-0.95 s: frame k from t[k]; then nuke2_cap

nuke2_cap_a.anchor: cap centre: draw at (gz.x, gz.y - zc) - (ax, ay)
nuke2_cap_a.note: cap frames 0..7 of 16 (nuke2_cap_a = 0..7, _b = 8..15); frame k from t[k]; zc = height of the cap centre above ground zero in world px (lerp zc between frames for a smooth rise)

nuke2_cap_b.anchor: cap centre: draw at (gz.x, gz.y - zc) - (ax, ay)
nuke2_cap_b.note: cap frames 8..15 of 16 (nuke2_cap_a = 0..7, _b = 8..15); frame k from t[k]; zc = height of the cap centre above ground zero in world px (lerp zc between frames for a smooth rise)

nuke2_glow.note: NIGHT only: smouldering underside kept longer (day cap frames stop glowing at 5.6 s). Draw frame j over cap frame cap_frames[j], same position, NOT darkened by the night tint

nuke2_stem.note: frame k from t[k] to t[k+1] (last until 6.8 s, it is dissolved by then); pixels reach top1[k] px above the anchor: crop the source rect from the top so the visible height = lerp(top0[k], top1[k], phase) (the cap hides the end); draw before the wilson ring and the cap

nuke2_wilson.anchor: ring centre: draw at (gz.x, gz.y - 0.55 * zc(t)) - (ax, ay)
nuke2_wilson.note: condensation ring 1.3-4.4 s (frame k from t[k], hide after 4.4 s); drawn after the stem, before the cap

nuke2_skirt_back.note: base dust skirt, back half (draw FIRST, under the stem); frame k from t[k] (0.3-8 s, the last frame is the dissolving one: fade it out 6.8-8 s)

nuke2_skirt_front.note: base dust skirt, front half (draw LAST, over the cap); frame k from t[k] (0.3-8 s, the last frame is the dissolving one: fade it out 6.8-8 s)

nuke2_wall.note: shock-front dust wall: frame = fade*8 + variant. Place ~2.2 chunks per world px of front radius (n = 2.2 * r + 16) on the uneven ring r * edge_noise(angle), variant = hash(i). fade 0 while r < 0.45 R, 1 < 0.8 R, 2 after, 3 while it settles (t 2.2-4.6 s, drop chunks by hash); gone at 4.6 s

nuke2_light.note: NIGHT only: stepped light pool on the map (rings 32/67/105/140 px), ADDITIVE above terrain/buildings and under the cloud, modulate 0.62 * (1 - t / 6.5)

nuke2_crater.note: crater 6.5 cells (r 26 px), from 0.4 s; later swap to nuke2_lake_0..3

nuke2_lake.note: crater lake stages 0 puddle, 1 half, 2 full, 3 settled (water + mud shore to 7.5 cells). Burnt rim with rubble, muddy shore, no grass / embankment; same anchor as nuke2_crater. Aliases nuke2_lake_0..3
